sections.title: Choose the right match record

sections.title: How we handle data
sections.html:
Each roster record carries a source. Retentions, auction listings and overseas signings are labelled separately. Conflicting reports remain flagged rather than being silently treated as final. Historical and international statistics must carry their own season, format and source.

Missing data is not zero. The 2026 player statistics remain unavailable until matches produce verified scorecards.

sections.title: Corrections
sections.html: Send the page URL, the disputed detail and a supporting source through our contact form. The form prepares an email draft for you to review and send.

sections.title: Reading our season records
sections.html:
A source-review date tells you when the listed information was checked; it is not a player signing date or a fixture announcement date. Historical news should be read with its publication date and any correction notice. The team and auction directories distinguish recruitment records from confirmed match selection.

Our privacy policy, terms of service and independence disclaimer explain the website’s scope. The site does not issue match tickets, accreditation or official tournament announcements.
